subject: [PATCH v3 6/7] selftests/mm: check MADV_PAGEOUT file permissions

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to the Linux kernel's selftests/mm suite to verify that the MADV_PAGEOUT functionality works correctly when used by an owner of a file or someone who can open it for writing. The test checks that the owner can page out clean pages of their own files, and that unauthorized callers cannot unmap shared file pages or page out COW pages from private mappings. The test also verifies that MADV_PAGEOUT can swap out anonymous memory and unmap clean file pages in /tmp. If any of these conditions are not met, the test skips itself to avoid false failures.
